remarks: *ALL Utilities included* Tucked away on a quiet dead-end street just minutes from downtown Greenwich, shopping, and schools, this charming two-bedroom upstairs apartment offers a fantastic location and tons of space. Enjoy a welcoming shared front patio and a spacious shared backyard-perfect for relaxing outdoors. Inside, you'll find a large eat-in kitchen and a generously sized primary bedroom, plus shared washer and dryer access. Conveniently located near the train, I-95, beaches, and local parks. This is a true hidden gem and move-in ready! Landlord kindly requests no more than 2 occupants.Good credit is a must.No pets please
